title: PDF document job request
description: HTML owns page geometry by default. When format, landscape, and margins are all omitted, the renderer must honor the HTML CSS @page size, orientation, and margins. Supplying any of those three fields explicitly selects renderer page-geometry overrides; print_background and page_ranges do not change the page-geometry source.

options.description: Rendering controls. Omit format, landscape, and margins to keep HTML CSS @page authoritative. Existing callers may continue to supply any of those fields to request renderer-owned page geometry.

format.description: Explicit renderer page-format override. Its presence selects renderer-owned page geometry.

landscape.description: Explicit renderer orientation override. Its presence selects renderer-owned page geometry.

margins.description: Explicit renderer margin override in millimetres. Its presence selects renderer-owned page geometry; omitted sides retain the renderer's legacy 10 mm fallback.
